# Nolan Norris Receives U.S. U-23 Men's National Team Call-Up

 Share on Facebook
 Share on X

FRISCO, Texas (Nov. 6, 2026) – FC Dallas Homegrown defender Nolan Norris has been called up to the United States U-23 men's national team for two upcoming friendlies in San Pedro del Pinatar, Spain. The U.S. will face Scotland on Nov. 15 and Ukraine on Nov. 17. [...] Norris has played a career-high 1,842 minutes across 24 appearances for FC Dallas this season. He scored his first goal of the season on April 25 against the Seattle Sounders and has recorded a career-high two assists. Norris leads FC Dallas Homegrowns in minutes played, goals and appearances this season.  
 With 33 career starts, Norris ranks ninth in FC Dallas Homegrown history, surpassing Ricardo Pepi, who recorded 28 starts.
